item.tib: rgyal ba'i bka' dang bka' rten rmad 'byung dgos 'dod yid bzhin gter gyi bang mdzod la dkar char blo'i tha ram bkrol byed 'phrul gyi lde mig
item.coloph: zhes g.yung drung bon gyi bka' rten (brten) 'di nyid rgyal ba'i dbang po'i gdung sob gsung rten 'phar chen rang grags kyi rten lung 'chang ba bla ming g.yung drung tshul khrims dbang drag (grags) bdag gis bstan 'gro yongs la phan bde rgya rnam mkhyen rgyal ba'i mgon po de nyid sku skye ba mi ru bzhes nas mi lo gcig khri bdun stong brgyad brgya go cher 'byung ched/ gnyis/ 'das pa'i 'tshams (mtshams/)rab tshes 'dzin byed zhes bya/ me pho byi ba'i bzhin ras ngom pas (pa'i) tshe/ mkha' yi thig le/ bum pa'i khyim du spyod pa'i dkar phyogs rgyal ba gsum pa'i gral tshes la dbu 'dzug nas/ slar gnam gnon zhes bya lcags pho 'brug lor nyin byed karkaT (kar+tha)la rol pa'i dkar phyogs rdzogs pa gsum pa'i gral tshes gza' skar legs pa'i nyin mthar son pa'o/ sarba mang ga lam/ bkra shis legs pa'i dge tshogs 'grub 'gyur cig tha tshan mu tsug smar ro/ zhal dro//
